title: 第25章 拿下木堡第26章 哈娜杜兰英三米之内
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
那支火箭以一个特别大的角度抛射而出，划过两百多米的距离，射进木堡，插在一间干草铺设的房屋屋顶。
箭头上的火苗点燃干草，火势瞬间蔓延开，整个小屋屋顶都燃起了大火！
“着火了！着火了！”
木堡了望塔上的士兵满脸惊骇，敲起警钟发出叮叮叮的声音，木堡里的人们着急忙慌的灭火。
可他们被哥布林围到现在，木堡里根本没多少水，好一阵救援后，只是没让火势蔓延，那间木屋还是烧掉了。
众人脸上黑漆漆一片，还有不少人烧伤，整一个的狼狈至极。
这还是对方只射了一箭，如果对方4个箭塔上站满人，同时射箭，他们全都得被烧死！
“怎么办？怎么办？快想想办法！”
哈娜小姐焦急大叫，试图让另外两人想点办法，可雷奥骑士只是表情阴郁的站在那里，蒙德管家也只是不停唉声叹气。
雷奥骑士无奈道：“没办法了，对方竖起的四座箭塔把我们的一举一动尽收眼底，而且对方的兵力短时间增加这么多，完全把城堡包围，我们已经无处可去了。”
哈娜小姐脸色苍白。
“真……真的没办法了吗？这……这就是我们的最后了吗……”
雷奥骑士无奈点了点头，他拔出腰间的匕首递给哈娜小姐。
“至少现在还有时间决定自己的命运，哈娜小姐你是女人，被哥布林抓住后是什么后果不用我说……哎，愿你回归光明神国。”
哈娜小姐颤巍巍接过匕首，她真不想死啊，身为王国魔法学院前10的学生，她本该有光明的未来，可却要在这了无人烟的魔法森林自裁，为什么会发展成这副鬼样子呢？
大滴大滴的眼泪滴下，她颤抖的将匕首抵住自己的脖子，雷奥骑士和蒙德管家不忍的闭上了眼睛。
生死间有大恐怖，哈娜小姐迟迟不敢自裁，比划了好几下都觉得不得劲，最终她放下匕首，寻思要不回去整点魔药喝死自己算了。
这时包围城堡的哥布林有了动静，一个大哥布林举着盾牌靠近围墙。
哥布矛大声朝上面喊道：“会说哥布林语的雌性在不在？俺老大说给你们个投降的机会，能让你们活！”
哈娜小姐一愣，下意识把这话翻译给另外两人。

另外两人也是呼吸粗重了几分，都是人，都不想死，哪怕对他们做出保证的是哥布林，他们也想看看有没有机会啊。
哈娜小姐靠近城墙，颤声问道：“你们首领怎么说？”
哥布矛大声喊道：“老大说了，我们的兵力是你们的6倍，还能随时把木堡烧成焦炭，取你们性命只在他一念之间！
但这座木堡造的还不错，他并不想将其烧毁，你们人类也是重要的劳动力，你们可以成为老大的奴隶，帮他干活，掌握知识的人还会获得更高的权力，你们的生命都能得到保障。”
content_en:
The rocket was thrown out at a particularly large angle, crossed a distance of more than two hundred meters, shot into the wooden castle, and was inserted into the roof of a house paved with hay.
The flame on the arrow ignited the dry grass, and the fire spread instantly, and the entire roof of the hut was ablaze!
"Fire! Fire!"
The soldiers on the watchtower of the wooden castle had a look of horror on their faces, and they sounded the alarm bell and made a tinkling sound. The people in the wooden castle hurriedly put out the fire.
But they had been surrounded by goblins until now, and there was not much water in the wooden castle. After a while of rescue, the wooden house was still burned down, although the fire did not spread.
Everyone's faces were pitch black, and many people were burned. They were all in an extremely embarrassed state.
This is because the opponent only shot one arrow. If the opponent's four arrow towers are full of people and they shoot arrows at the same time, they will all be burned to death!
"What to do? What to do? Think of a solution!"
Miss Hana shouted anxiously, trying to get the other two to think of something, but Knight Leo just stood there with a gloomy expression, and Butler Mond just kept sighing.
Knight Leo said helplessly: "There is no other way. The four arrow towers erected by the opponent can have a panoramic view of our every move. Moreover, the opponent's troops have increased so much in a short time and completely surrounded the castle. We have nowhere to go."
Miss Hana turned pale.
"Is...is there really nothing we can do? This...is this the end for us..."
Leo Knight nodded helplessly, pulled out the dagger from his waist and handed it to Miss Hana.
"At least you still have time to decide your own destiny. Miss Hana, you are a woman. I don't need to tell you what the consequences will be if you are caught by the goblins... Hey, I hope you return to the Kingdom of Light."
Miss Hana took the dagger tremblingly. She really didn't want to die. As a top 10 student at the Kingdom Academy of Magic, she should have had a bright future, but she had to commit suicide in this uninhabited magic forest. Why did she develop into such a horrible state?
Big drops of tears fell, and she put the dagger to her neck tremblingly. Knight Leo and Butler Mond couldn't bear to close their eyes.
There was great terror between life and death. Miss Hana did not dare to commit suicide. She made several gestures but felt unsatisfactory. Finally, she put down the dagger and thought about whether she should go back and prepare some magic potion and drink herself to death.
At this time, the goblins surrounding the castle made some movement, and a big goblin approached the wall holding a shield.
Gob Spear shouted loudly upward: "Is there a female who can speak Goblin language? My boss said that I will give you a chance to surrender so that you can live!"
Miss Hana was stunned and subconsciously translated this to the other two people.
The other two people were breathing a little heavier. They were both humans and they didn't want to die. Even if it was the goblin who made the guarantee to them, they wanted to see if they had a chance.
Miss Hana approached the city wall and asked in a trembling voice: "What did your leader say?"
Gob Mao shouted loudly: "The boss said that our military strength is 6 times that of yours, and we can burn the wooden fort to charcoal at any time. He can only take your lives in one thought!"
But this wooden castle is well built, and he doesn't want to burn it down. You humans are also an important labor force. You can become the boss's slaves and help him work. Those who have knowledge will also gain higher power, and your lives will be guaranteed. "
